cycle.source: cycle_channel_v16.json: structural R^-2 2.283e-13/window + additive R^-1 1.510e-7/window, measured at R=32/64/128

policy.record_fields: 32B canonical key || 20-bit trail || 108-bit step; no coefficients
policy.rule: every hit replays both trails from their stored identities; the replay decides triviality (da=db=0) and, if nontrivial, recovers x=-da/db; rejected hits are charged their own replay
policy.scanner: rows are drawn uniformly: r = (x(S) ^ t*2654435761 ^ trail*7919) mod R, so tuple enumeration is uniform over R and carries no weight beyond the measured hit rate
policy.why_no_six_steps: v16's six-step allowance was not derived from an implemented escape rule and the escape was deleted; here a return costs no extra step because the walk continues from the true point and t advances, so only the 4 spent steps are charged

record.layout: 32B canonical key || 16B identity (20-bit trail || 108-bit step); no coefficient field, so a hit's triviality is only knowable at replay

sort.counters: 4 x u64 (256-bit) per bucket on every pass; at V=2^127.67 a bucket holds ~2^111.67 records, so no pass can use a 32-bit count
sort.executed: ./radix17 20 -> sorted=1 collisions=256 n=1048576 elems=16777216 moved=16777216 bytes=805306368
sort.scope: GLOBAL: the sort spans the whole store, so a hit can be between any two visits of the challenge, not only inside one 2^20 batch

success.note: success = at least one coefficient-nontrivial collision that recovers x, measured per trial on the global store; useful_per_collision = 1.0 in every ladder cell, so the success event is witness existence, not a mean collision count
